tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: J'achète des pommes et des gâteaux.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Qu'est-ce que tu lis le matin ?” The verb tile is the infinitive: you choose the form.

B hears the question and builds the answer. The noun and adjective tiles are in the singular: put them in the plural. Most take -s (des pommes), nouns in -eau / -eu take -x (des gâteaux, des bijoux), nouns in -al become -aux (des journaux, des chevaux).
Adjectives agree too: des chemises blanches, ils sont gentils. Words already ending in -s, -x or -z do not change (des fils).
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
